payload.prompt: What is Microsoft Foundry?

options.text: An Azure platform for enterprise AI work
options.rationale: Microsoft Foundry is an Azure platform for enterprise AI operations and application development. It includes a model catalog and broader development capabilities.

options.text: A screen for testing deployed models
options.rationale: This describes a playground rather than the full platform. A playground is one place for interactive testing.
options.better_fit: Use this for a question about testing a deployed model interactively.

options.rationale: An API is a code interface for sending requests. Foundry is the Azure platform that organizes enterprise AI work.
options.better_fit: Use this when code must send a model request.

options.rationale: An image-generation model is a specific AI capability. Foundry is the platform used to develop and operate AI applications.
options.better_fit: Use this when the task specifically requires creating or editing images.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Foundry is the broader Azure platform.

payload.prompt: Is the following statement accurate?
payload.statement: Microsoft Foundry is only a playground for testing models.
payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. The playground is only one part of Foundry.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This narrows a platform to one testing activity.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Foundry supports enterprise AI operations and application development.

payload.prompt: Complete the statement.

parts.text: Microsoft Foundry's model catalog includes Microsoft and

payload.explanation: Foundry's catalog includes both Microsoft and partner-provided models.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The catalog source would be named incorrectly.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Use partner-provided models for models supplied by partners.

payload.prompt: Which data types can a multimodal model work with at the same time? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Text is a supported multimodal data type. It can be combined with other input types.
Images are a supported multimodal data type. They can be considered with written input.
Audio is another data type multimodal models can work with. Multimodal means more than one type of data.
Multimodal models are not restricted to image pixels. They work across multiple input types.
options.better_fit: Use this for an image-only processing task.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Multimodal models work with multiple data types.

payload.prompt: Which term means a model can work with text and images together?

options.rationale: Multimodal means working with more than one data type. Text and images are two such types.
A vision-enabled GPT model is a kind of multimodal model. The question asks for the broader category.
options.better_fit: Use this when the model is specifically GPT with vision.

options.rationale: Image generation models create or edit images. They do not name combined text-and-image understanding.
options.better_fit: Use this when the task is to create or edit an image.

options.rationale: Object detection identifies objects in images. It does not describe the broader ability to work with text and images together.
options.better_fit: Use this when the task is limited to identifying objects in an image.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Multimodal models handle multiple input types.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: One input would be left out.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Multimodal models combine more than one type of data.

payload.prompt: A shopper uploads a shelf photo and asks, "Which products are missing?" Which abilities must the chosen model have? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: The shelf photo supplies visual evidence. The model must accept it to inspect stock.
The shopper's question supplies the requested task. The model must use it with the photo.

options.text: Combine both inputs in its response
options.rationale: The answer depends on both the shelf and the question. Combined input understanding is the needed capability.
A new video does not answer the shelf question. The task is to interpret supplied image and text inputs.
options.better_fit: Use this when the business needs a newly created video.

feedback.intrinsic: The shopper would receive a clip rather than the missing-product answer.
feedback.instructional: Choose multimodal understanding when a photo and written question must be used together.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. The task requires combined image and text understanding.

payload.prompt: What does a vision-enabled GPT model combine?

options.rationale: Vision-enabled GPT models interpret visual input. They respond in natural language.
Editing and remixing are media-generation activities. They do not define GPT with vision.
options.better_fit: Use this for image editing or video-remix capabilities.

options.rationale: Object detection is a narrow vision task. GPT with vision supports broader visual reasoning and language responses.
options.better_fit: Use this when only object identification is needed.

options.rationale: Text-only generation does not process visual input. Vision-enabled GPT combines visual understanding with language responses.
options.better_fit: Use this when no image or other visual input is involved.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. GPT with vision combines visual understanding and language.

payload.prompt: What can a vision-enabled GPT model do? Select all that apply.

options.text: Describe an image in natural language
options.rationale: It can interpret an image and describe it. Natural-language responses are a core capability.

options.text: Answer a question about a photo
options.rationale: It can use a photo with a written question. It then provides an informed language response.
Vision-enabled GPT supports flexible visual reasoning. It is not limited to one narrow image task.

options.error_type: Confuses vision reasoning with video generation
options.rationale: Video generation is a different capability. GPT with vision is defined by understanding visual input and replying in language.
options.better_fit: Use this for a video-generation request.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. These are visual-reasoning capabilities.

payload.prompt: True or false?
payload.statement: A vision-enabled GPT model can understand images but cannot give natural-language responses.
payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Natural-language responses are part of GPT with vision.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A suitable model would be ruled out.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Vision-enabled GPT combines image understanding with natural-language responses.

parts.text: GPT with vision can reduce the need for deep

payload.prompt: A support lead receives damaged-product photos and needs the app to inspect each photo and reply in plain language. Which model should the lead choose?

options.rationale: The task needs photo understanding and a language response. A vision-enabled GPT model provides both.
Image generation creates or edits visual output. The lead needs an explanation of an existing photo.
options.better_fit: Use this when the goal is to generate or edit an image.

feedback.intrinsic: The customer could receive a new image instead of a damage explanation.
feedback.instructional: Choose GPT with vision for visual understanding followed by a written reply.

options.rationale: Object detection can identify objects but may not explain visible damage. The task needs broad visual reasoning and language.
options.better_fit: Use this when only object identification is required.

feedback.intrinsic: The reply could identify an object without explaining the damage.
feedback.instructional: A vision-enabled GPT model better fits general visual inspection and natural-language responses.

options.rationale: A text-only model cannot directly use the damaged-product photos as evidence. The task requires visual understanding before producing a reply.
options.better_fit: Use this when all relevant information is already available as text.

feedback.intrinsic: The app would lack the visual evidence needed to assess the damage.
feedback.instructional: Choose a vision-enabled GPT model when the response depends on inspecting images.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. GPT with vision fits image inspection plus a written response.

payload.prompt: What is visual reasoning?

options.text: Interpreting visual input and giving an informed response
options.rationale: Visual reasoning interprets what is visible. It produces an informed response, often in natural language.

options.text: Drawing a new image from text
options.rationale: Text-to-image generation creates new visual output. Visual reasoning interprets existing visual input.
options.better_fit: Use this when a description must become an image.

options.rationale: Object detection is a specific visual task. Visual reasoning can interpret broader visual meaning.
options.better_fit: Use this when the task is limited to identifying objects.

options.rationale: Image segmentation separates an image into regions. Visual reasoning interprets the visual information to form an informed response.
options.better_fit: Use this when image regions must be identified or separated.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Visual reasoning interprets visual meaning and responds.
